verdict.rationale: Recurring or scheduled job execution is a fair axis for a GPU rental platform, but the evidence never documents cron-style schedules or recurring workflows. What it does show is related but different: TTL, end-time and spend-cap auto-deletion, one-off `lium exec` jobs, and SDK run-and-remove calls. These control a pod's lifetime or run a single job; they do not schedule repeat runs. A user could build recurrence with an external scheduler, but that is a user-side workaround and earns no credit.
